question: Can successive snapshots identify the joining and separation of naturally emerged material-rich regions?
histories: All driven and clock/supply perturbations, plus reversible_df0.2 at both registered sizes. Retain the other two reversible controls for the primary interpolation only.
comparison: Identify periodic six-neighbor components in the width-4 density above the threshold. A link between two successive times requires both sufficient geometric overlap and enough shared material identities. Summarize one-to-one, many-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many and unlinked components for the whole bipartite graph. Record actual links and frames for reproducibility.
limits: These are observable transitions at the sampling cadence. Mergers, dispersal, overlap between moving objects and mask changes can happen between observations. Only fixed thresholds and retained identity links contribute to the labels.
